en.text:
Grants <pve 25% /> <pvp [5%] /> Damage Resistance (Resist x2) to you and allies inside Rifts you create. (<solar/>Well of Radiance does not count but you can cast a Rift inside it for the benefits)

Reaching Critical Health grants the Dearly Departed buff, granting <pve 50% /> <pvp [25%] /> Class Ability Energy.

Buff lasts until you are no longer at Critical Health, essentially serving as a cooldown.

Dying spawns a Healing Rift at your location.
